title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode7 Sparkling Days

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You sure look like you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You might say that. You look pretty happy yourself, you know.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, this SEKAI did just give birth to a brand new song. Nothing makes me happier than that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's great that all four of them were able to find their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sure is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They even said they're going to keep coming back to practice, too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I can't wait for our next session!
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miku! Luka! We came to practice!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Speak of the devil.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone's here! Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry for just showing up like this.
We aren't interrupting anything, are we?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Please, there's no need to be so worried.
You're welcome to come any time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'd like to get right to it, then.
Would you join us for a session?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, stop being in such a hurry!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course. What song should we start with?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, I'd like to play the one that was created here. I've been practicing it a lot lately.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's get started, then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, you four are really improving quickly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shiho, you were already really talented to begin with, but you've gotten much better at helping others keep up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What a relief. I've been really nervous I wouldn't be able to keep up, but I think I did all right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm glad you were able to find your rhythm again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! Miku, Luka, guess what?! We've been thinking about writing our own songs instead of just performing other people's!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, really? That sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was going to try to write some music that would go well with these lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, those are the ones from my notebook!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I said you could make a copy, but I didn't know you were going to show Miku and Luka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Well, of course! Your lyrics are really good!
I wanted to see what they thought.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But it's still only a few phrases that I was thinking of using. I don't think you can really call them lyrics just yet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even our time apart was not time wasted.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now that we're together, everything is brighter.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be sure to treasure every moment as we run into the future.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I like them! They're so full of your emotions, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let us know when it's finished. I'd love to perform it with you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great! I'll get to work on it right away!
Hona, Shiho, would you give me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? But I've never written any music before. I suppose I might be able to give some advice on the rhythm.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Have you thought at all about the basic melody?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! For this part that goes, Even our time apart was not time wasted. I thought we could...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: C-Could you not keep reading them out loud?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone looks so excited.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As do you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're thinking you can't wait to sing and perform with them again, aren't you? I can see it in your eyes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Am I that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm really looking forward to singing their song once it's finished.
